title: Rep-Pilot
subtitle: Mobile-first workout tracking & progression
summary: Plan reusable workouts, record every set, and get explainable recommendations for what to lift next.

sections.title: The experience
sections.body: Create workout templates, log set-level performance, and review training history and personal records. Session snapshots preserve the plan you started with, even if you edit the template later.

sections.title: Progression with reasons
sections.body: A deterministic double-progression engine considers rep targets, effort, pain, and recent performance. It recommends increasing, maintaining, reducing, or reviewing the load, with explicit reasons. Pain triggers review, and repeated underperformance can trigger a reduction.

sections.title: Data integrity
sections.body: A normalized PostgreSQL schema stores templates, sessions, exercises, and sets. Supabase row-level security isolates each user’s data. Completing a session and saving its progression recommendations happens in a single database RPC.

sections.title: Engineering approach
sections.body: Business rules and validation live in feature modules behind thin Next.js routes. The pure progression engine is covered by Vitest tests; React Testing Library supports UI testing.

sections.title: OpenAI explanations
sections.body: An OpenAI-powered explanation layer for translating the deterministic progression engine’s decisions into conversational language.
